text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me. What was that just<n>now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Why does it... feel like I've been<n>enveloped in
warmth?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
How strange... There's power welling<n>up from deep
inside of me, but I still<n>feel so calm.
